mutations.name: admit-while-paused
mutations.why: A paired destination accepts work after the owner's pause.

mutations.name: dispatch-after-stop
mutations.why: The hub can stop after fallback preparation but before its dispatch.

mutations.name: worker-enters-busy-checkout
mutations.why: A new worker enters while an older worker still runs or cleans up.

mutations.name: late-worker-ignores-epoch
mutations.why: A starter delayed past a core crash can mutate the next generation's checkout.

mutations.name: setup-ignores-checkout-sha
mutations.why: Setup or a check starts on a different commit than its request.

mutations.name: cancel-returns-before-cleanup
mutations.why: A cancelled request returns while a spawned worker or its cleanup remains alive.

mutations.name: worker-ignores-unreadable-epoch
mutations.why: A delayed worker acts after its epoch has become unreadable.

mutations.name: repair-corrupt-epoch-without-evidence
mutations.why: The hub advances a damaged epoch instead of refusing the checkout.

mutations.name: core-group-kills-b-owning-supervisor
mutations.why: A supervisor killed with the core releases B while its separately grouped setup child survives.
